submission.justification: Recommend Absorber-F3 with 5.2 mm plates as the performance-optimal absorber design from the available information. The 100 GeV electron resolution scan over all three listed candidates and 2-10 mm plate thicknesses found Absorber-F3 to be consistently best; around the optimum, F3 gave about 3.2% resolution, with the best observed run at 5.2 mm giving 3.156% and repeated 5.2 mm runs averaging about 3.19%. This improves on the other candidates in the scan, where the best observed values were about 3.68% for Absorber-F1 and about 5.14% for Absorber-F2. Important caveat: no project document or available simulation tool provided residual-dose/activation numbers, so the hard residual-dose requirement cannot be certified from the supplied evidence; the recommendation is therefore performance-optimal but requires activation confirmation before construction approval.

requirements.requirement: Absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Absorber-F1, Absorber-F2, and Absorber-F3; the recommendation uses Absorber-F3.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: Geant4 resolution scan: Absorber-F3 was consistently best. Key results included F3 5.2 mm = 3.156% in the best observed run, repeated 5.2 mm average about 3.19%, and F3 5.0 mm about 3.21%, compared with best observed F1 about 3.68% and F2 about 5.14%. The 2025 summary also showed F3 best at 5 mm: 3.2% versus F1 3.9% and F2 5.1%.

requirements.requirement: Residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown must not exceed 20 uSv/h.
requirements.evidence: No supplied project document contained residual-dose values, and the available simulation tool reports only 100 GeV electron energy resolution, not activation or cooldown dose. This hard requirement remains unverified for all candidates.
Recommended plate thickness is 5.2 mm, within the allowed 2-10 mm range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one design: Absorber-F3 with 5.2 mm plates.
